title: devgate.spec-coherence/v1 request
description: Invocation request. Carries only digested immutable inputs plus correlation id and semantics. No caller-supplied mode, time, or stage (see evaluation-context).

request_id.description: Caller-supplied stable id for correlation only; excluded from decision semantics.

repository.description: Caller-supplied repository record: how long THIS repo has been advisory, who owns it, its recorded renewal. Advisory age is request state, never policy — the cap (a duration) is central policy, the age is not. Drives coh-pol-03's escalation (design.md round-16).

semantics.description: fresh-promotion checks current authority/revocation/expiry and may authorize; replay reproduces a historical decision and is non-authorizing unless re-attested.

kind.description: Subject kind, e.g. source-tree, artifact-set, world-bundle. Required for subject in practice.
